job.prompt:
Answer the 27 problems below. Reply with one line per problem, `Q<n>: <answer>`, and nothing else.

Q1. A walker on a street grid goes from corner (0, 0) to corner (8, 7), each step moving one block east (x increases by 1) or one block north (y increases by 1). How many such routes pass through corner (4, 3)? Answer with an integer.
Q2. Compute 6958 × 7892. Answer with an integer.
Q3. A hiking trail is 34.5 miles long. Using 1 mile = 1.609344 km, how long is it in kilometres? Give the answer rounded to 2 decimal places (round only at the end).
Q4. A bicycle is priced at $292. The price is raised by 25%, the new price is then cut by 20%, and finally 5% sales tax is added. What is the final amount paid? Give the amount in dollars, rounded to the nearest cent (round only at the end).
Q5. A deposit of $5,500 earns 3.5% interest per year, compounded annually. What is the balance after 3 years? Give the amount in dollars, rounded to the nearest cent (round only at the end).
Q6. How many integers from 1 to 418 inclusive are divisible by 4 or by 7, but not by 8? Answer with an integer.
Q7. A lab has 6 chemists and 10 physicists. In how many ways can it choose a committee of 3 chemists and 2 physicists? Answer with an integer.
Q8. A tank holds 30.9 US gallons. Using 1 US gallon = 3.785411784 litres, how many litres does it hold? Give the answer rounded to 2 decimal places (round only at the end).
Q9. A loan of $10,000 accrues interest at 4% per year, compounded every six months, and no payments are made. How much is owed after 2 years? Give the amount in dollars, rounded to the nearest cent (round only at the end).
Q10. Compute 9796 × 3874. Answer with an integer.
Q11. Pipe A fills an empty tank in 8 hours and pipe B fills it in 13 hours. A drain empties a full tank in 20 hours. If the tank starts empty with both pipes and the drain open, how many hours does it take to fill? Give the answer rounded to 2 decimal places (round only at the end).
Q12. A parcel weighs 37.9 pounds. Using 1 pound = 0.45359237 kg, what is its mass in kilograms? Give the answer rounded to 2 decimal places (round only at the end).
Q13. Divide 7536 by 53. Give the answer rounded to 2 decimal places (round only at the end).
Q14. How many positive integers less than or equal to 600 have exactly six positive divisors? Answer with an integer.
Q15. Divide 9117 by 71. Give the answer rounded to 2 decimal places (round only at the end).
Q16. Compute 6792 × 8769. Answer with an integer.
Q17. How many litres of a 30% salt solution must be added to 14 litres of a 13% salt solution to obtain a 22% salt solution? Give the answer rounded to 2 decimal places (round only at the end).
Q18. Find the sum of all positive integers n such that n + 6 is a divisor of n² + 100. Answer with an integer.
Q19. A bakery sells 238 loaves a day at $6.50 each. After it raises the price by 30%, daily sales fall by 15%. By what percentage does daily revenue increase? Give the percentage rounded to 2 decimal places.
Q20. Divide 5678 by 37. Give the answer rounded to 2 decimal places (round only at the end).
Q21. Convert 105.6 degrees Fahrenheit to degrees Celsius, using C = (F - 32) × 5/9. Give the answer rounded to 2 decimal places (round only at the end).
Q22. How many distinct arrangements are there of all eight letters of the word TOMATOES? Answer with an integer.
Q23. A van drives 25 km at 70 km/h, then 35 km at 90 km/h, then 145 km at 40 km/h. What is its average speed for the whole trip, in km/h? Give the answer rounded to 2 decimal places (round only at the end).
Q24. Compute 3895 × 8344. Answer with an integer.
Q25. Two cyclists start 50 km apart and ride toward each other on the same road. The first rides at 20 km/h. The second rides at 25 km/h but sets off 20 minutes after the first. How many minutes after the first cyclist sets off do they meet? Give the answer rounded to 2 decimal places (round only at the end).
Q26. Two fair six-sided dice (faces 1 to 6) and one fair eight-sided die (faces 1 to 8) are rolled together. The probability that the three numbers rolled are the side lengths of a triangle with positive area is m/n, where m and n are positive integers with no common factor greater than 1. Find m + n. Answer with an integer.
Q27. Divide 5823 by 17. Give the answer rounded to 2 decimal places (round only at the end).
